speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry can work with the Ministry of Manpower and consider having an improved Employment Pass specifically to attract and retain foreign nurses at our restructured hospitals.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, are we reviewing this work pass conditions because we know that there was very high attrition of foreigners.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, if you are going to hire the 4,000 new nurses, of which many are foreigners, and they come and work with the same conditions, I think we are going to have an equally high attrition rate.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, specifically, can we look into whether they can bring their dependants because many left because they want to go back to their families.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Again, I hope the Senior Parliamentary Secretary can review that and allow some of them to bring their dependants to Singapore as well

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I understand the issues that he has raised and, in fact, these are some common concerns we have heard.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), Written Answers to Question Nos 27 and 29-43 on the Order Paper are reproduced in the Appendix.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The remaining Questions have been postponed to a later Sitting of Parliament or withdrawn.]
